text: The project was on life support. After months of setbacks, the team finally pulled the plug.
notes: Extended metaphor - medical to business context

text: The patient was on life support. After months in the hospital, the family finally pulled the plug from the machine.
notes: Literal medical context - actual life support

text: John walked into the interview with confidence. He was a lion entering his territory, ready to claim what was rightfully his.
John walked into the zoo exhibit with caution. A lion was entering its territory, ready to claim the space that was rightfully its.
notes: Literal - actual lion in its territory

text: The old library was a treasure chest of knowledge. Books lined the walls like precious gems, each one containing worlds waiting to be discovered.
notes: Extended metaphor with simile - library as treasure

text: The old attic contained a treasure chest from the estate sale. Jewelry lined the compartments with precious gems, each piece carefully wrapped and waiting to be appraised.
notes: Literal - actual treasure chest with gems

text: The news hit her hard. She stood frozen, like a statue in the town square, unable to process what she had just heard.
The ball hit her hard during practice. She stood there for a moment, starting at a statue, before shaking her head and continuing the game.
The company's stock plummeted overnight. Investors watched in horror as years of growth evaporated into thin air.
The puddle on the sidewalk disappeared overnight. Pedestrians watched as the water evaporated in the morning sun.
The garden had been neglected for years. Weeds had declared victory and now ruled over their conquered territory with thorny authority.
The garden had been neglected for years. Weeds had spread throughout and now covered the ground with thorny stems.
The words hung in the air between them. Neither wanted to reach out and grab them, afraid of what might happen if they acknowledged the truth.
The banner hung in the air between them, suspended by wires. Neither wanted to reach out and grab it, afraid they might tear the delicate fabric.
notes: Literal - physical object hanging in air

text: The deadline approached with relentless determination. Each tick of the clock was a footstep drawing nearer, hunting her down.
The footsteps approached with relentless determination. Each footstep was louder as the security guard walked down the hallway, checking each office.
Memory is a fickle companion. One moment it shows you vivid scenes from your past, and the next it abandons you when you need it most.
My travel companion was fickle. One moment he wanted to visit museums, and the next he changed those plans to go to the beach instead.
The old house creaked and groaned in the wind. It was telling stories of generations past, whispering secrets only it remembered.
The old man creaked and groaned as he stood up. He was telling stories of generations past and whispering details only he remembered.
notes: Literal - person making sounds and telling stories

text: Her mind was a battlefield. Thoughts charged at each other with reckless abandon, casualties mounting with each passing moment of indecision.
The area was a battlefield. Soldiers charged at each other with reckless abandon, casualties growing with each moment of combat.
The city never truly sleeps. It merely dozes, one eye always open, watching as people move through its veins at all hours.
The baby never truly sleeps through the night. She merely dozes, one eye opening frequently, watching as her parents move through the house at all hours.
The first chapter was merely the appetizer. The author spent the rest of the book serving up a feast of ideas that left readers intellectually satisfied yet hungry for more.
The first course was merely the appetizer. The chef spent the rest of the meal serving a feast of dishes that left diners physically satisfied yet wanting more dessert.
The negotiation was a delicate dance. Both parties circled each other cautiously, neither willing to make the first significant move until they understood their partner's rhythm.
The ballroom dance was delicate. Both partners circled each other cautiously, neither willing to make the first significant move until they understood their partner's rhythm.
Depression is an unwelcome houseguest. It arrives without warning, makes itself at home, and refuses to leave no matter how unwelcome it becomes.
My cousin is an unwelcome houseguest. He arrived without warning, made himself comfortable at home, and refuses to leave no matter how many times I ask.
The courtroom fell silent as the witness took the stand. The atmosphere was as thick as fog, making it difficult for anyone to breathe normally.
The surrounding trees fell silent as the group entered the valley. The fog was thick, making it difficult for anyone to see the path clearly.
The political campaign started strong but quickly lost momentum. What had begun as a mighty river was now barely a trickle, struggling to reach its destination.
The mountain stream started strong but quickly lost volume. What had begun as a big river was now a trickle, hardly able to flow to the valley below.
The algorithm learned from each interaction. With every piece of data it consumed, it grew smarter, more efficient, evolving beyond its original programming.
The student learned from each interaction with the tutor. With every piece of information she learned, she grew smarter and more efficient at solving problems.
Social media is a double-edged sword. It connects us across vast distances while simultaneously building walls between people sitting in the same room.
The kitchen knife is a double-edged sword. It has sharp edges on both sides, making it useful for certain cuts but dangerous to handle carelessly.
The forest welcomed them with open arms. Branches swayed in greeting, and leaves whispered secrets as they passed beneath the ancient canopy.
The host welcomed them with open arms. She gestured warmly in greeting, and spoke quietly as they moved through the entrance into the house.
Climate change isn't a distant threat. It's a predator already in our midst, stalking its prey with patient determination, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
notes: Extended metaphor - climate change as predator

text: The wolf isn't a distant threat to the livestock. It's a predator already in the area, stalking its prey with determination, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
The symphony built slowly toward its climax. Each instrument added its voice to the conversation until they were all shouting in perfect harmony.
The debate built slowly toward its climax. Each speaker added their voice to the conversation until they were all shouting in disagreement.
Their relationship had weathered many storms. Now, in calmer waters, they navigated with the confidence of sailors who had seen the worst the sea could offer.
notes: Extended metaphor - relationship as sea voyage

text: Their sailboat had weathered many storms. Now, in calmer waters, they navigated with the confidence of sailors who had seen the worst parts of the sea.
notes: Literal - actual boat in storms and calm waters

text: Grief comes in waves. Sometimes it's a gentle ripple that you can step over, and other times it's a tsunami that knocks you off your feet and drags you under.
The ocean comes in waves. Sometimes it's a small ripple that you can step over on the beach, and other times it's a big wave that knocks you off your feet and pulls you under the water.
The old professor was a living library. His mind contained volumes of knowledge, carefully cataloged and accessible through the simple act of asking a question.
The university building was a large library. Its shelves contained volumes of books, carefully cataloged and accessible through the simple act of searching the database.
The startup ecosystem is a jungle. New companies must adapt quickly or be devoured by larger predators that have mastered the environment through years of evolution.
The rainforest ecosystem is a jungle. New animals must adapt quickly or be eaten by larger predators that have mastered the environment through years of evolution.
The painting captured more than just a scene. It imprisoned a moment in time, holding it captive for future generations to witness and experience.
The photograph captured more than just a scene. It recorded a moment in time, preserving it for future generations to witness and view.
The debate quickly turned hostile. What began as a civilized exchange of ideas transformed into a battlefield where words were weapons and facts were the first casualties.
The protest quickly turned hostile. What began as a peaceful gathering transformed into a violent confrontation where objects were thrown and people were injured.
The abandoned factory stood as a monument to a bygone era. Its empty halls echoed with the ghosts of machinery and the memory of busy hands that once gave it purpose.
The war memorial stood as a monument to a bygone era. Its empty halls echoed with footsteps and displayed photographs of soldiers that once gave it meaning.
Trust is like a mirror. Once broken, you can fix it, but you'll always see the cracks in the reflection, reminders of the damage that was done.
The bathroom mirror broke. Once broken, you can glue it back together, but you'll always see the cracks in the glass, reminders of the damage that was done.
